// diagnostic

E1361

An inline `package { … }` declaration appears more than once.

What

An inline `package { … }` declaration appears more than once.

Why

One source file has one Package identity; accepting a second block would make facts, outputs, and authority ambiguous.

Fix

Keep one leading `package { … }` block and remove the duplicate.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1361: tests/ui/inline_package_duplicate.stderr.

Error [E1361]: An inline `package { … }` declaration appears more than once.
  --> tests/ui/inline_package_duplicate.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | package { name: "two" }
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: One source file has one Package identity; accepting a second block would make facts, outputs, and authority ambiguous.
 Fix: Keep one leading `package { … }` block and remove the duplicate.
